title: Dynamics kernel estimator: scale-unidentified, silent fallback to start values
description: R/dynamics.R:104-151. process_correlation normalises so (tau_b,tau_g,sigma_e) are unidentified; BFGS walks ridge, eigen fails, tryCatch returns START values with identified=TRUE. norm_stable (ell=Inf) never fits. Fix: simplex parameterization + bounded log(ell), L-BFGS-B, check convergence, never silent fallback, stable+nugget when lags fixed, report normalised variance fractions. Also A4: NA velocity/forecast quantities when unidentified. Add OOS test on irregular lags: var(innovation) in 1±0.1, FPR in 0.05±0.015. Review A3/A4.

title: Fix site scale adaptation bias (E[log|Z|] = -0.635)
description: R/adapt.R:47-50 uses mean(log|r/s|); identical-site adaptation shrinks sigma to 0.55x, held-out var(z)=3.2-3.9. Fix: 0.5*log(mean((r/s)^2)) with z=qnorm(centile); add test that identical-site adaptation leaves var(z)~1. Review A2.

title: Derive covariates from spec formulas, not all non-outcome columns
description: R/fit.R:30,45,260. Covariates are every non-outcome column: NA in unused columns silently drops rows; Mahalanobis support is computed over other outcomes; predict errors if unused column absent. Fix: all.vars() over spec formulas; complete-case on outcome+those; message dropped rows. See docs/review-2026-08-22.md A1.

title: Cut dead/half-baked surface: gamlss engine, ordinal/discrete, parallel.R, as_wide, filter_scores, dead utils; merge velocity/stable/card; internalize scale_*/fortify_*
description: See docs/review-2026-08-22.md section B. Drop Matrix and scales Imports. Wire future.apply into norm_fit directly.

title: NA predictors error on location-scale fits; seed/determinism for uncertainty='total'
description: engine-mgcv.R:121, dist.R:44 (A8); engine-mgcv.R:616 unseeded 64 draws, cdf() ignores draws (A9). Also non-syntactic outcome names (A11).

title: Tail/boundary handling: log-space tails, no 1e-12 clamp, ecdf boundaries, joint n_observed

title: Collapse norm_calibrated/norm_adaptation/norm_reference class stacking into predict.norm_fit
description: predict.norm_adaptation ignores allow_extrapolation, drops total draws and .id, never applies calibration, returns plain tibble; norm_reference drops norm_calibrated class. One norm_fit with optional $calibration/$adaptation slots and a shared scores_from_dists(). Review A6.

title: norm_select calibration gate and CRPS are in-sample
description: R/select.R:50-59,107: split_for_assess is a stub. Compute gates from crossfit scores; paired-difference SE for the 1-SE rule; actually use CRPS. Review A5.

close_reason: Analytic and package-level FPR sweeps: change_z stays near 5% across r/lag/noise; naive Z2-Z1 does not.

title: SHASH should beat Gaussian on skewed OOS scores
description: Add a statistical gate: on strongly skewed data, SHASH has better held-out log score, more uniform PIT, and flatter worm residuals than a Gaussian location-scale model.
close_reason: SHASH beats Gaussian on skewed OOS log score, PIT, and worm residuals; Gaussian stays competitive on Gaussian data.
